signals.title: Puppet Show: "Don't Look for Trouble" (Не си търси белята)
signals.reason: A bright, physical puppet show about friendly garden bugs that is very engaging and easy to follow for an English-speaking 4-year-old.
signals.note: dropped: venue cap (2/venue); Confirmed via pptheatre.com and grabo.bg.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "Chuk and Puk" (Чук и Пук)
signals.reason: A fun and educational stage classic featuring two cheeky trolls that teaches young kids about brushing their teeth through playful physical humor.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "Puss in Boots" (Котаракът в чизми)
signals.reason: Expressive puppetry bringing the classic fairytale to life, easily paired with a visit to the beloved Stara Zagora Zoo just an hour from Plovdiv.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "Monkey Adventure" (Приключение с маймунка)
signals.reason: A cheerful, musical animal puppet performance with simple rhyming and visual antics ideal for preschoolers.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "The Little Bread Loaf" (Житената питка)
signals.reason: The Bulgarian folklore counterpart to The Gingerbread Man, filled with funny woodland animal encounters that keep preschoolers enthralled.
signals.note: dropped: venue cap (2/venue); Confirmed via pptheatre.com and grabo.bg.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "The Boy and the Wind" (Момче и вятър)
signals.reason: A magical, visual retelling of a classic folktale using inventive puppetry, stage effects, and music.
signals.note: dropped: venue cap (2/venue); Confirmed via pptheatre.com and opoznaiplovdiv.bg.

signals.title: Young Wine Festival 2026 (Дефиле на младото вино)
signals.reason: Brings the Old Town to life with festive food stalls, folk music, and tastings, offering an engaging excuse to wander the courtyard spaces together.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "Winnie the Pooh" (Мечо Пух)
signals.reason: Beloved, familiar characters and gentle storytelling that an English-speaking 4-year-old will instantly recognize and adore.

signals.title: Family Musical: "Christmas Glue for Fathers" (Лепило за брада)
signals.location: City House of Culture "Boris Hristov", Plovdiv
signals.reason: A festive daytime musical by the State Opera Plovdiv choir and ballet that kicks off the Christmas spirit with lively costumes and songs.

signals.title: Kapana Christmas Market 2026 (Коледен базар Капана)
signals.location: Overpass bridge over Gladstone St / Central Square, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Festive holiday village with wooden chalets, sweet treats, twinkling lights, and photo installations that make a cozy evening walk for a toddler.

signals.title: Children's Railway "Zname na Mira" Miniature Train Ride
signals.reason: An authentic mini train journey through tunnels and over bridges up Youth Hill, followed by large playgrounds at the bottom.

signals.title: Krumovo Aviation Museum (Музей на авиацията)
signals.location: Krumovo Air Base, near Plovdiv Airport
signals.reason: Only 15 minutes away, offering vast open lawns and dozens of real passenger planes, jets, and helicopters where a preschooler can roam freely.

signals.title: Ayazmoto Park & Hall of Laughter
signals.reason: A massive pine forest park with broad buggy-friendly paths, fun house sensory curved mirrors, and an easy combination with the Stara Zagora Zoo.

signals.title: Plovdiv Jazz Fest 2026 (Fall Edition)
signals.location: Boris Hristov House of Culture, 15 Gladstone St, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Top-tier international jazz festival featuring Rosen Zahariev's Miles Davis Centenary project, Aaron Parks Trio, and Shai Maestro. Entirely instrumental and musical with zero language barrier.

signals.title: Kinomania 2026 Opening Night: Martin McDonagh’s 'Wild Horse Nine'
signals.location: LUCKY Dom na Kinoto, 1 William Gladstone St, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Opening night of Kinomania festival featuring the dark comedy by Martin McDonagh starring John Malkovich, Sam Rockwell, and Steve Buscemi. Screened in original English audio with Bulgarian subtitles.

signals.title: Art Exhibition: 'The Beginning. 130 Years. Until Today.'
signals.reason: Major museum-grade retrospective celebrating the 130th anniversary of the National Academy of Art, juxtaposing classic Bulgarian masters with leading contemporary faculty. Visual format with dual Bulgarian/English text.

signals.title: Northern Carriageway Closure on Blvd. 'Bulgaria'
signals.location: Blvd. 'Bulgaria' (between Blvd. 'Tsar Boris III Obedinitel' and 'Vasil Levski' St), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Complete closure of the northern carriageway for traffic light gantry replacement and maintenance; bus lines 4 and 16 rerouted.

signals.title: Emergency Intersection Closure: Blvd. 'Aleksandar Stamboliyski' at 'Industrialna' St
signals.location: Intersection of Blvd. Aleksandar Stamboliyski and Industrialna St, South District, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Emergency road closure enacted due to localized collector flooding and pumping station failure; traffic diverted to alternative routes.
signals.note: Past event; municipal authorities reopened the intersection on November 3 per bnr.bg and trafficnews.bg, with no active closure starting November 6.

signals.title: Roadworks and Traffic Delays on Rogoshko Shose Artery
signals.location: Rogoshko Shose (from Severen Blvd outward), north-eastern Plovdiv
signals.reason: Final segment of deep utility trenching and resurfacing resumed, causing substantial peak-hour traffic bottlenecks on the north-eastern exit corridor.

signals.title: Bunardzhik Hill Sunset Walk
signals.reason: A paved, tranquil climb to panoramic 360-degree viewpoints over Plovdiv and the Thracian plain, completely free and requiring no Bulgarian.
